generation_guards: Show exactly five mushrooms, exactly four toys, and exactly four bears.
Bind pink color only to the mushrooms and white color to the bears.
Make the toys behind the bears while keeping all four toys at least partly visible.
Place all five mushrooms on top of the four toys; do not place mushrooms on the bears or ground.
Avoid occlusion that hides counts; keep each object separable and countable.
Do not add extra mushrooms, toys, or bears.
initial_plan.generation_strategy: Use a layered spatial composition with four white bears in the foreground, four distinct toys in a middle row behind the bears, and five pink mushrooms resting on top of the toys. Keep the toys' upper surfaces visible above or between the bears so the mushrooms-on-toys relation is clear, and separate all objects enough for reliable counting.
initial_plan.initial_prompt: A clear layered scene with exactly four white bears in the foreground, arranged side by side. Directly behind the bears are exactly four distinct toys, partially but clearly visible, positioned as a middle row behind the bears. On top of the four toys are exactly five pink mushrooms total: place one pink mushroom on top of three of the toys and two pink mushrooms on top of the remaining toy. The mushrooms must visibly rest on the toys, not on the bears or ground. Keep all four white bears, all four toys, and all five pink mushrooms separated and countable, with no extra bears, toys, or mushrooms and minimal occlusion.
